# 🟦 Exis Craft

Created by: Exis
Minecraft Version: 1.20+
Mod Loader: Forge / Fabric (choose your version)
Category: Adventure • Exploration • RPG • Combat
Multiplayer Support: ✅ Yes

## 💬 Description

Hey, it’s me — Exis! ^^
I’m a German YouTuber and this is my first Minecraft mod.
It’s nothing too crazy, but I wanted to make something fun — a little mix of new ores, weapons, mobs, and some surprises!

Exis Craft expands your Minecraft world with fresh content and a bit of humor.
If you enjoy exploring, crafting new stuff, or fighting weird creatures, you’ll probably have a good time here.


# ⚙️ Main Features


## 🪨 New Ores & Materials
Discover mysterious underground resources — each with unique crafting uses.


## 🗡️ New Weapons & Equipment
Forge powerful tools, blades, and armor sets that give you a fighting chance against new enemies.


## 👾 New Mobs (Good & Evil)
Meet friendly creatures that might help you — and dangerous ones that definitely won’t.


## 🏆 Custom Advancements
Earn new achievements and rewards as you explore everything the mod has to offer.


## 🌍 World Additions
Some biomes, structures, and loot tables have been slightly updated to fit the new content.


# 🎮 Why You Should Play

To be honest… I don’t really know 😅
But if you like chaotic fun, exploration, and new gear, this mod might be exactly what you need!
It’s not about realism — it’s about having fun and trying something new.


# 🔧 Compatibility & Requirements

Works with Minecraft 1.20+

Available for Forge and/or Fabric (depending on release)

Fully compatible with most other adventure / exploration mods

Can be used in singleplayer or multiplayer worlds


# 📦 Installation

Download and install Forge or Fabric for your game version.

Drop the Exis Craft .jar file into your mods folder.

Launch Minecraft and enjoy!

Optional but recommended:

Install JEI (Just Enough Items) to see crafting recipes easily.

Combine with worldgen mods for more exploration fun.


# 💙 Credits

Created and developed by Exis
Thanks to everyone supporting my small YouTube channel and testing early versions!

If you make videos or share the mod, please credit “Exis Craft” and link back to this page ❤️


# ✨ Final Words

This is my first mod — it’s not perfect, but I hope it makes you smile or gives you something new to explore.
Have fun mining, crafting, and fighting your way through the world of Exis Craft! 🐑⚔️
